cases.input: The autoclave on the second floor of the clinic keeps aborting its cycle halfway through and never reaches sterilising heat. We can't process instruments until it's sorted.
cases.rationale: Installed steriliser is failing to perform; corrective work is being requested.

cases.input: Bed seven in the greenhouse is being flooded because the irrigation solenoid stays open after the timer finishes. Can an engineer free it or swap it out?

cases.input: Lift B in the residential tower has been stalling between the fourth and fifth floors since Tuesday evening. Residents are using the stairs until it is put right.

cases.input: Classrooms in the east wing are cold again. The boiler burner lights and then cuts out a few minutes later, so the heating never gets going.

cases.input: Our spiral mixer makes a grinding sound and the bowl lift is stuck halfway. Tonight's dough can't be made until it's working.

cases.input: The exit barrier at the staff car park accepts the ticket but the arm refuses to lift, so drivers are queuing. Please get it moving again.

cases.input: The walk-in freezer in the kitchen is icing over on the evaporator and the temperature has crept up to minus eight overnight.
cases.rationale: Implicit fault report on in-use refrigeration; the only sensible service is corrective.

cases.input: The rack UPS in the comms cupboard is beeping constantly with an amber battery light. Someone needs to deal with it before we lose the switches in a power cut.

cases.input: The push bar on the rear fire exit of the theatre has to be shoved hard before it releases. It should open at a touch, so please adjust or replace the mechanism.

cases.input: Chlorine at the leisure pool has dropped because the dosing pump runs but pushes nothing through the line. We need it back in service before tomorrow's swim school.

cases.input: The treatment chair in surgery three slowly sinks while a patient is in it, even with the brake set. The hydraulics need looking at and fixing.

cases.input: The unloading auger on the grain bin trips its overload every time we start it with grain in the trough. Harvest is backing up behind it.

cases.input: The floodlight mast over yard C flickers and then goes dark for minutes at a time after sunset, leaving the forklift drivers working blind.

cases.input: Guests on the third floor report the showers only run scalding hot. The thermostatic mixers in those rooms need attention today.

cases.input: The sliding entrance doors at the library shudder and stay wide open whenever there's any wind, and the heating is going straight out.

cases.input: Fume cupboard 4 in the chemistry lab keeps sounding its low-flow alarm even with the sash fully down. It is out of use until the extract is corrected.

cases.input: The transmitter cabinet at the hilltop site shuts itself down on hot afternoons. The cabinet fans don't seem to be turning any more.

cases.input: There is a growing puddle of glycol under the chiller that cools our fermentation tanks, and the tank temperatures are climbing.

cases.input: Water drips from the ceiling tiles above desk cluster 12 whenever it rains heavily. Please find where it's getting in and stop it.

cases.input: Treadmill six at the fitness centre jolts and stops at random mid-run. Two members have nearly fallen, so it's taped off until it's fixed.

cases.input: Charging point 3 in the visitor car park shows a red fault ring and won't start a session for anyone. Please reset or repair it.

cases.input: Call buttons in bay D of the ward no longer light up the panel at the nurses' station. Please get them working again.

cases.input: The lathe in the training workshop gives off a hot electrical smell after ten minutes and the spindle slows under load. Something in the motor is going.

cases.input: We need a prepaid return label for the wrong-size filters that were sent to us last week, so they can go back.
